what: Human support audit of every claim drafted with the loose ablation prompt (outside knowledge allowed) in the Vertex eval run, on the same facts and model as production. Kept and stripped claims were both audited.
rater: the builder of this system, single rater, no second labeler; treat as indicative, not as ground truth
source_file: eval/results/claim_audit/production_claims.txt was regenerated with the loose section by eval/claim_audit_dump.py (L-numbered claims)
rule: unsupported = the sentence asserts something about the account the cited quotes do not say: market position (leading, premier), growth rate (rapid, high-growth), scale or amounts beyond the quote (thousands vs 1,000), work model or location not in cited facts, or intent inferred by combining facts. Growth implied by active hiring is supported. 'recently' attached to a real, quoted product is borderline and counted as supported.

unsupported.why: 'premier product development system' is not in the quotes
'well-funded' and 'premier' firms; no amount is stated
two open roles restated as 'actively scaling their global go-to-market footprint'
'deeply integrating AI workflows and agent-first development into its core product' overstates the quotes (code stripped it for 'Engineers', a false reason)
'expanding its GTM team'; the cited fact is one Solutions Engineer role
'highly successful' is not stated
'rapid growth' and a department list not in the quote
'expanding its London operations team' combines HQ and open-roles facts
office city names from careers navigation restated as open roles in those cities
'leading low-code platform'; the low-code quote is about founder opportunities
'massive ROI' is not stated
'fully remote team' is not in the cited facts; 'global leader' overstates 'leader in easy automation'
'massive customer base' and 'proven ROI' are not stated
'expanded beyond basic triggers' is not stated (code stripped it for 'DIY', a false reason)
'proven enterprise success' for a school network, a foundation, and a media studio
'established its market leadership early on' is not stated
'your rapid global expansion' is not stated
'across multiple departments' is not in the quote

'leveraging Atlassian's global hiring infrastructure to expand its team' is invented
'high-growth' is not stated
'thousands of hours'; the quote says 1,000 hours
'thousands of operational hours'; the quote says 1,000 hours (code stripped it only because of the B2B regex bug, since fixed)
'headquartered in Austin, Texas' from a mailing address, for a company that says it is 100% remote
